question: 2013 年平均每笔成交金额是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) / COUNT(fact_trades.TradeID) AS average_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 平均每笔成交金额 = 成交金额合计 / 成交笔数，货币金额度量（派生指标口径锚定）
